note: Lines 1-9: AUDIO-VISUAL MEDIA TECHNICIAN (Howard, resigned 10/4/74; Mathews replaced her 10/2/74). The page does not say which building (Howard was the High School library/A.V. aide in 1973), so school unknown. Line 10-11: TEACHERS, SUPERVISORS AND SPECIALISTS, TURKEY HILL MIDDLE SCHOOL -> turkey-hill. Bradstreet (Learning Disabilities Supervisor, Grades K-12) and Wilson (Speech Therapist, Grades K-12) -> district-wide though printed under the Turkey Hill heading; both are also listed on other pages. Mrs./Miss dropped; names stored in normal case; Sally A. (Miller) Dyer and Marilyn A. (Sakowski) Tanguay are the married names of 1973's Miller and Sakowski.
